'''Trella Bare'Ah''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] dancer who worked in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. She was also the lover of [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]].

==Biography==
During the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she met a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] and was romantically involved with him.

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Trella was present in the palace with a few Twi'leks when [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]] and his son, [[Ion Papanoida/Legends|Ion Papanoida]] were searching for Greedo. She went to them and asked what they wanted from Greedo. When the Chairman told her that he was here to hire a bounty hunter, Trella went to find Greedo and told him about the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantorans]] that were searching for him.

{{Char-stub}}
